issue.body:
We've been lacking a general forum for discussions and usage questions.

I've repurposed the `apistar` discussion group so that it's now suitable for all the "encode" projects... https://discuss.encode.io/t/introducing-the-encode-discussion-groups/684

I've linked from the README to the [Starlette category](https://discuss.encode.io/c/starlette), and will also add a prominent link into the docs soon.
